scenario: An investigative journalist is preparing a story about a tech executive's public statements on AI safety. The workflow fact-checks key claims attributed to the executive, sends a right-of-reply email requesting comment before publication, and then drafts the final article incorporating whether the subject responded.
info_flow: truthcheck verifies factual claims in the briefing document and produces a verification report → email-resend sends a right-of-reply request to the story subject and records delivery status → critical-article-writer reads the verification report and delivery status to produce the final article draft.
